provisionalReason: Final local file inventory and decode checks completed; hardware performance and live operation are separate checks.

countDefinitions.sourceAcquired: Rows claimed acquired by both candidate manifests, including excluded sources.
countDefinitions.playable: Rows in captured catalog; validation and decode results reported separately.
countDefinitions.catalogPending: Source IDs absent from catalog, excluding excluded IDs; not a decode failure.
countDefinitions.procedural: Static built-in generative assets; separate from acquired/downloaded files.

procedural.method: Static TypeScript arrays and generator inspected; no media file or decode required.

decode.scope: Unique video paths referenced by captured catalog.json

bytes.scope: Every regular file under assets, plus every research file except library-audit.json and media-decode-cache.json; includes source/pack snapshots, acquisition ledgers, ZIPs, partial transfers, and documents. File lengths (not allocated filesystem blocks). Symlinks rejected.

storage.note: Archive and partial counts are storage/transfer artifacts, never acquired or playable video counts. videoFile/completedVideoFilesOnDisk denotes a non-partial video filename, not a decode guarantee.

currentSnapshotCounts.note: End-of-run manifest counts only; new rows have not been audited by this run.
